data.one_liner: A Flutter plugin providing a WebView widget based on Apple's WKWebView control.
data.what_it_does: It implements Apple's WKWebView for Flutter applications on iOS and macOS platforms. It supports loading files, cookie management, JavaScript windows, and external native APIs.
use_when: You need to render web content inside your Flutter application specifically targeting iOS and macOS.
You are using the endorsed webview_flutter package and need platform-specific WKWebView parameters or direct API access.
avoid_when: You need a cross-platform solution that also covers Android, as this package is strictly for iOS and macOS.
You want to avoid platform views and native web components.
strengths: Native Apple WKWebView implementation with high performance.
Supports external native APIs for iOS applications and packages.
Endorsed plugin that automatically integrates with webview_flutter.
weaknesses: Limited only to iOS and macOS platforms.
Relies on platform views which can come with platform-specific limitations or rendering bugs.
data.setup_notes: Endorsed plugin, so it is automatically included when using webview_flutter. Can be added to pubspec.yaml directly if importing it for platform-specific APIs.

alternatives.name: webview_flutter_android
alternatives.why_pick_it: Use if you need the Android implementation of webview_flutter instead of Apple's WKWebView.

alternatives.name: webview_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: Use the main high-level package instead of the platform-specific implementation directly.
